__comment: The films and series of your Plex servers, and those shared with you, in Videos. Signs in through plex.tv/link with a code, or takes a server's address; Videos and Plex keep each other's place. The customUI app org.webosports.app.videoauth asks for what the provider needs and calls org.webosports.service.videos/login with this templateId, which checks it before Accounts stores the account.
__comment2: org.webosports.app.videoauth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs as the customUI app. org.webosports.service.videos reads the credentials for every catalogue call.
